items.title: Nutcracker Wreath with Dried Oranges
items.alt: Evergreen wreath with pinecones, dried orange slices, burgundy ribbons and a cream-and-green nutcracker.
items.description: Dried orange slices and copper-brown cones brighten the evergreen ring. A cream-and-green crowned toy sits at its lower edge beneath a large burgundy bow.

items.title: Nutcracker in a Crescent Music Box
items.alt: Seated plum nutcracker reading a small book inside a pale wooden crescent rocking music box.
items.description: A pale crescent cradles the seated nutcracker as he holds a small open book. Carved gold stars, plum lining and a side winding key decorate the curved rocking base.

items.title: Nutcracker Ornament in a Blue Gift Box
items.alt: Small orange-jacketed nutcracker ornament with a gold hanging loop inside a tissue-lined blue box.
items.description: Pale tissue cushions the orange-jacketed ornament beneath its large hanging loop. The blue lid rests beside the open box, secured with a plain cream bow.

items.title: Seated Nutcracker Bookend
items.alt: Seated wooden nutcracker bookend in a green cap and red jacket supporting four plain clothbound books.
items.description: The seated figure forms the upright side of a dark wooden bookend. Its green cap and red jacket sit beside four plain books with brown, red, ochre and cream spines.

items.title: Articulated Paper Nutcracker Kit
items.alt: Flat paper nutcracker with brass joints, a pull string, craft scissors and two spare fasteners.
items.description: Brass fasteners connect the paper figure's shoulders and hips. A loose string, curled blue hat, long plum boots and small craft scissors give the puppet kit its flat diagonal layout.

items.title: Drummer Nutcracker Snow Globe
items.alt: Clear snow globe containing a green-jacketed drummer nutcracker above a dark red star-decorated base.
items.description: White snow flecks surround the crowned drummer inside a round glass globe. Bright reflections trace the glass, while gold stars decorate the dark red wooden base.
